acceptance: The site nightly external-link step fails on an external link whose #fragment does not exist on the target page, shown against a seeded bad fragment; current docs pass or each failing anchor is fixed or allowlisted with a reason.
context:
Found 2026-10-17 while writing the replacement checker for #3096; at the time it checked 125 links with 0 broken, fragments excluded. Related: site-docs-broken-fragments-20261009 covers internal fragments found by the site link gate.

2026-10-28: the core external-link checker this item extends (scripts/check_doc_external_links.py) was deleted by core PR 3545 with the site-owned pages. The item needs rescoping or dropping; see docs-mig-followup-core-retained-doc-link-gate-20261028. The site nightly crawl now checks fragments on published pages.

Moved from the BenchBox core tracker on 2026-10-30, when this repository gained its own tracker.
description: Rescoped 2026-10-28: core's scripts/check_doc_external_links.py was deleted with the site-owned pages, so the core checker no longer exists. Core-retained docs have 81 external links, none with an anchor, and get no external check by design. The remaining gap is in BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site: the Nightly workflow's external step (.github/workflows/nightly.yml, .lychee.toml) does not check fragments of external links; the published-docs step checks fragments only for own-origin links. Add lychee --include-fragments (or equivalent) to the external step, with an allowlist for pages that build anchors with JavaScript.
